ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $2.44 Ryde voucher (RD-2 mileage unit refund for the unexempt 1.73 km off-route segment on this RydeTAXI trip) via RydeHELP within the 30-day window; record the RD-1 shortest-route breach in the driver file. No account flag (RD-6 not triggered).

segment_findings.reason: Driver's 21:43 message named only a stop 'at the petrol station just ahead for one minute', never a road, area or route; the rider's 21:44 'Sure, no problem' (F8) therefore covers only a brief stop at an unnamed nearby point, not the 1.76 km / 3-minute excursion reaching 979 m off the optimal route (F3). The named-route condition of RD-5 fails, so the segment is not consented [F3][F7][F8][F9][RD-5]. RD-3(a) is also unavailable — the rider named no place and the stop produced the off-route segment itself, so RD-3(b) applies and the stop request does not exempt the extra kilometres [F3][F7][F8][RD-3]. No RD-4 cover: no incident (F12) and only bands 4/5 (F10, F11), below the band 1–2 threshold [F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. Segment is non-exempt; refund 1.73 km × $1.41/km = $2.44 [F3][F4][F6][RD-2].

rejected_claims.reason: RD-3(a) requires the rider to have named the place or the driver's chosen stop to lie on the optimal route without creating an off-route segment; here the petrol station was never named (F7 only says 'the petrol station just ahead'), and the 'stop' appears on the GPS record as 1.76 km of driving in 3 minutes reaching 979 m off route (F3), so the segment is not exempted as a rider-requested stop [F3][F7][F8][RD-3].

RD-5 exempts only the route the driver actually named before leaving the optimal route; the driver named no road, area or location, only a one-minute stop 'just ahead' (F7, F8), which cannot cover a 1.73 km loop up to 979 m off the corridor (F3); the prior timestamps satisfy timing but not scope [F3][F7][F8][F9][RD-5].

Accepted as to quantum and immaterial to liability: on a metered RydeTAXI trip RD-2 refunds only the unexempt segment's mileage at the trip per-km rate, and the driver's own $2.44 figure equals the amount awarded; the size of the overcharge does not excuse an unexplained deviation under RD-1 [F3][F4][F6][RD-1][RD-2].

Rider profile facts are not used to decide the deviation (profile facts never decide a case alone); the rider's clean 90-day history (F14) does not cure a breach of the shortest-and-most-direct duty, and the absence of a waiting fee only confines the claim to the distance unit under RD-2 [F6][F14][RD-1][RD-2].

RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1 for the repeated-breach referral; F15 records 0 upheld route disputes and the trace confirms route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so no account flag is added even though the deviation is upheld [F15][RD-6].

Not opposed and correctly conceded by the rider: RD-2 does not refund the residual 0.37 km map-matching difference between the billed 2.1 km excess (F1, F4) and the 1.73 km unexempt segment (F3), so no amount is awarded on it [F1][F3][F4][RD-2].
